title: SFBond 실버폭스 #072 · 이레즈미 · 사각 오크 대들보 결박 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · blue-black Senegalese · early 50s · 헤어 vintage victory rolls framing the face
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Senegalese woman, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s silver fox goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white vintage victory rolls framing the face — full body peony irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING VIVID PINK peony blooms cascading full torso both legs neck to ankle, ELECTRIC GOLD centre highlights filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a calm, distant gaze. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a massive square-cut rough-hewn oak timber beam mortised into two square oak posts that stand on either side of her, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a second square oak timber mortised into the same two posts at ankle height, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her feet spread about shoulder-width apart. Pose: standing full height between the supports, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, fingers softly curled and relaxed, her head tipped very slightly forward, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long stiletto glossy nails pink gold tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
